communication_obligations: S4.3: describe duty of care as an entitlement. It is never goodwill and never offered instead of compensation.
Our records show flight AK307 on 2 Aug was cancelled for a technical reason (within Aerlink’s control).
Compensation is assessed on arrival delay at the final destination, not on departure delay. Your actual arrival delay into Madrid was 270 minutes (4 hours 30 minutes).

For a Band A journey with that delay, the compensation due is £220 per passenger. We have issued this £220 payment today; this is the full amount owed under the policy for this disruption (S10.2, S5).

Duty of care was owed because the flight was cancelled. If you incurred reasonable costs, you can claim reimbursement against receipts up to the caps: meals/refreshments £30 per passenger per 6 hours, two calls or equivalent, hotel £180 per room per night (max 3 nights), and transport £45 per journey. Care is an entitlement regardless of cause and is separate from compensation (S4).
